changelog:
Argus Design Review Skill v0.3.3

- Adds detailed SKILL.md documenting audit standards for design tokens, hardcoded values, dark mode, accessibility, CSS/HTML quality, and framework-specific API usage.
- Includes clear detection workflow for technology stack (React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, Astro, Lit, Vanilla CSS).
- Provides explicit anti-patterns and violation examples for each supported frontend stack, starting with React.
- Defines audit rules for design tokens, hardcoded values, dark mode coverage, accessibility (WCAG AA), CSS/HTML structure, and framework best practices.
- Enumerates trigger phrases in both English and Chinese for invoking the review skill.
summary: Use when reviewing frontend code for design quality — checking design token usage, hardcoded values, dark mode coverage, accessibility compliance, CSS consistency, semantic HTML, or framework API usage. Use when auditing a component, page, or design system for issues. Trigger phrases: '帮我 review 这段代
